cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Supportive Rage
cards.instruction: Remain helpful and encouraging while becoming increasingly furious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can change your birthday lunch. I'll handle the cancellation; we don't simply fail to turn up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I want the seaside place, but we'd lose your forty-pound deposit here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Forty pounds down the drain. Fine, you deserve your sea view. Let me confirm a window table before you pay anyone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've paid another forty. They say a window table costs extra.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then request the actual supplement, not 'extra.' Give me the phone. Bloody hell, you're getting that view even if I have to price every pane.

reason: Make A corrective booking expertise organise continued support while each actual cost raises anger; B premature payment changes A next negotiation.
